data.name: Pawar
data.gender_notes: Pawar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pawar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pawan' which means wind, and it is believed to bring the power and strength of the wind god. This name is bestowed upon a child to instill in them a sense of protection and guardianship, as well as the qualities of strength, courage, and victory. The name Pawar carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Pawar usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are protectors of dharma, who uphold righteousness and justice in the world.
data.etymology: Pawar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pawar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Historically, the wind god Vayu is one of the key deities in Hindu mythology, and is revered for his unyielding and transformative power, which is reflected in the name Pawar.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Pawar is associated with the qualities of protection, strength, courage, and transformation. The wind god, Vayu, represents the power of change and the transformative energy of the universe. This name is believed to instill in the child a deep sense of inner courage, resilience, and the ability to overcome challenges and obstacles.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Pawar in Hindu tradition symbolizes the one who protects and nurtures, like a mighty elephant or a caring parent. It embodies strength, wisdom, and the power to provide for and shield loved ones.

historical_references.reference: Pawar is a Maratha surname derived from the princely state of Pawardhan, which is located in the present-day Indian state of Maharashtra.
